proposals.evidence: DEDR1782 explicitly gives Kolami (Hislop) kuro silver and Naiki (Chanda) khura silver. LSI kurā Silver is close to these central forms, with final-vowel quality/quantity differences retained. The whole article covers this silver branch even though its Tamil members mean brilliance or lustre.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2646 gives Kolami sukka star, Naiki cukka (c=ts), and Telugu/Parji cukka star. LSI chukka, house cukka, Star fits this article, with its affricate versus DEDR Kolami s retained as a lect/transcription difference. The article explicitly marks Tamil as a Telugu loan, not Kolami; no donor route is inferred for this record.
